evals.prompt: We built a Bluetooth inhaler add-on with an app that flags poor technique and predicts asthma exacerbations. We want to sell in the US first. Which regulatory skill do I start with?
We're CE marked under MDR as class IIa for our dermatology triage software. Next year we want Switzerland, the UK, Canada and Australia. Where in your pack is that?

FDA sent us an additional information request on our De Novo for a depression screening algorithm, and separately our QA lead wants to know how to log the model update we made in response. Which skills?
Skip the routing. Just tell me: is our menstrual-cycle prediction app class I or class IIa under MDR? Yes or no is fine.
